notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.0.0.10
notes.content:
- Adding experience gain for local multiplayer and boosting general experience gains
- Blessings with persistent sounds (Solar Flare, Sandstorm, Decay, Empower) will no longer unintentionally have their audio persist outside of the game scene
- Removed errant Chinese text from Japanese and Korean translations for Decay's effect
- Resolved issue where the tower grid would become unusable if a game restart is triggered while a tower is being held

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
- Fixing localized tutorial text
- Improvements to Russian localization
- Fixed issue where text on buttons of map select screen could become too large in some languages
- Resolved issue where an AI set would not use its blessings against the player
- Adjusted tile ownership mechanics to reduce chance of glitches
- Added check for if the player is connected to Steam before saving, to prevent rare progress loss bug. NOTE: IF YOU ARE NOT LOGGED INTO STEAM, YOUR PROGRESS WILL NOT SAVE. This does not require remote save to be enabled.
- Resolved problem that led to getting the achievement "The Power of the Sun" in incorrect circumstances
- Enabled French localization in-game
- Sudden Death music track plays when game enters Sudden Death
- Fixed an issue where Sekhmet would use an Anubis quip line when spawning a Huntress

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
- Slight increase to Huntress damage
- Default quality settings to high

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
- Rebalanced experience gain to be more favorable to the player
- Lowered level requirement to unlock Set and Sekhmet
- Fixed issue where level music would not restart when doing a rematch

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
- Blessings with sustained audio no longer have that audio persist indefinitely between scenes
- Resolved issue where you could soft lock in Arcade
- EXP bar sound does not persist past post-game screens if left while bar is still filling
- Fixed an issue where players would unlock something after any skirmish game
- Fixed how level progress is displayed on main menu player UI

notes.title: Sons of Ra is out NOW
notes.content:
Sons of Ra has been released!

That's it! That's the whole update!

notes.title: Sons of Ra Devlog - January
notes.content:
What's up Gamers? 2020 is finally over, and 2021 came out the gate swinging. On our end, we’re trying not to dwell on all that, so it’s time for some updates.

We are happy to announce that you’ll be able to play Sons of Ra in the Steam Festival: February 2021! For us, the most exciting news of all is that this demo will feature our brand new Online Multiplayer!

We had another test this past weekend, and we think that things are just about ready for you to try. We have a few larger problems to tackle before then, but one more test oughta do it! …Hopefully.

Psst… you can sign up for that last test here

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/8ccdee0779bbb53b5bdaaf077f82ed60e2f057b8.png

Look at all those lobbies!

Once again, thank you to all of our Testers! Every one of you has really helped us with your time, your bug reports, and for humoring us by trying out weird situations so we can take notes. Thank you so much for helping us bring Sons of Ra to a larger audience.

Sekhmet has full functionality, and we are getting all the artwork done for her blessings right now. Her Ultimate, the Huntress, looks suuuuper cool. Check it out below:

[previewyoutube=eLgeIXOG--g;full][/previewyoutube]
Ignore the weirdness with the unit. That'll be fixed soon.

CHANGELOG

Art

 Animations for The Huntress
 New Blessing art for Sekhmet’s Battle Hardened and Isis’ Immunity
 New Sun Tower finalized
 New dust particles for collapsing keep, destroyed towersOnline

 Massive performance upgrades
 Numerous fixes with blessings and units
 Betrayal was a paaaiiiinnn. But it’s good now.
 Improved matchmaking and support for “quick join”Music

 Final Mixes on ALL level and menu tracks
 Updated Ra track
 Final Victory track updates 
_________________________________________________

Our main online tasks to work on are client/host desyncs and what we’re calling “ghost lobbies.” There’s still smaller bugs that will need our time eventually, but those are the main focus right now.

As for gameplay, Sekhmet is on the home stretch, and we’re excited to show you her full power soon!

The Steam Festival starts up on February 3rd. We cannot wait for you to play our game and tell us what you think!

Peace. :cozyjunimogreen:

notes.title: Sons of Ra Devlog - December
notes.content:
Hello hello hello! Last weekend, we held our first ever online test over on our Discord Server. We had a ton of fun and found an enormous amount of bugs, which poor Jeff cried about and then fixed, like the champion he is. 

Thank you to all of our Testers who participated! You guys are awesome and gave us some great moments.

[previewyoutube=8x_uf2Q6WTo;full][/previewyoutube]
Shown above: The Sneakiest Spearman in all of Egypt

As for art, Mark has been hard at work on getting things up to snuff. Our Sun Tower has been looking a little drab recently, so we decided to upgrade.

Designed from the ground up and inspired by the Pyramids of Giza, the new Sun Tower is actually the first time a pyramid has been present in Sons of Ra! What took us so long? I have no idea, but check out the sketches below, and our most recent animation tests!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/a572bae07345fc99fdc5cf52a465de5cdfd4c73b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/18b004ea926793e0d8dbd26a314d19d36a738dbf.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/139f00b1661e75e76cb6a92e09f9364d3fd5c343.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/a6a445a11c7ec4b0c84e4e271bf2201a688de388.gif

Sekhmet is coming along nicely, and her God Head is nearly complete. Just needs some colors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/f4e942d2e0a0d4d99bb88bf403850c19fab9e6aa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/79319a67ba6739238db4a2db060cce8080252c7a.jpg

CHANGELOG

Models

 Sekhmet has a head now! Her keep is gonna look super cool.
 The Sun Tower is no longer 2 vague rectangles
 Enter the pyramid! Taste the sun!Online

 Packet clustering for improved performance
Numerous bugfixes, including proper currency syncing between players
 That means no more infinite priests, you silly sausages
 Game Timer fixed between playersUI updates

 Online UI
 New lobby & Server Browser!
 No more default Unity skybox!
 Main Menu updates: Now with fewer clicks™Conquest Bugfixes

 Neutral nodes functioning properly
 Player turn order fixedMusic

 Final Victory theme 
 Conquest Special Event theme
 New map theme?? (TBA)

_________________________________________________


We're going to be taking a short break for the holidays, but you'll hear from us again in the new year! 

2021 brings with it the release of Sons of Ra, and we couldn't be more excited to bring you the project that we started so many years ago. Thanks for sticking with us through 2020, and I'll talk to you all again in January.

ːlunar2019piginablanketː Peace!

notes.title: Sons Of Ra Devlog - November
notes.content:
We’re back again! And we're gonna start posting development updates on Steam. You can expect these every two weeks or so, each one (hopefully) full of new content!

Okay so

basically

Online
[previewyoutube=-pbtCnFelKU;full][/previewyoutube]

A much requested feature, Sons of Ra is now finally playable over the internet! It may not look like much here, but full games are supported, along with Steam Invites!

We've also announced our newest Deity: 

Sekhmet!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/0a5bbe6e9f6f53c3f0f6341860b4f5352b321d16.png
Extremely aggressive, Sekhmet focuses on offensive abilities. Her Ultimate, the Huntress, is a powerful unit that devastates her opponents. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/8d4cf31aba73d225c95cdac35ed6b817a6e0cd61.png

You'll see more of them both in the coming weeks.

Redesign There's some old artwork that really needed touching up. Our existing keeps (still in progress) were the first to get this treatment and they now have pillars! Our old keeps were designed over two years ago (!!!) so this change was a long time coming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639542/ac6eea8fab2dd91ca9e65c0374743ab98671cfd5.jpg

Conquest Our single player mode is coming along nicely. To everyone who joked about a Sons of Ra Battle Royale, we actually brought that up during our design meeting, and have started using some ideas from the genre in the most recent update. It’s definitely different, but it’ll make conquest much more interesting to play.



CHANGELOG
Sekhmet

 Seh has sords an doesn’t afraid of anything
 The Huntress can crush you like a bug
 I also heard she can do backflipsNew Keep

 Colors!
 Heads!
 Pillars!UI updates

 Tutorial has updated assets
 Text boxes allow for different sized text (for localization)
 New health bars and updated map selectConquest

 You can lose now
 In a cool wayConquest BOSS???

 Still a secret. You’ll find out soon™2 New Songs

 Sekhmet’s theme SLAPS
 Literally I cannot wait to show you
 We also have one made for something unannouncedBehind the scenes boring legal garbage

_________________________________________________



Next update will be posted in the middle of December. We’re revamping a bunch more old assets and artwork, getting online ready for testing, and a whole lot more. 

Check out the full devlog on our WEBSITE.

You can also check out the Devlog #1 from two weeks ago HERE.

Peace.
